speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and have a history of easy bruising. Can you tell me if you have ever had prolonged bleeding after other surgeries or dental procedures?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your family history of joint swelling and bleeding issues, do you personally experience frequent or spontaneous bleeding into your joints? I also need to know if your bleeding time or platelet count has ever been tested previously.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the bleeding into your joints occur spontaneously or only after trauma, and have you ever experienced bleeding into your muscles? I also need to know if you have had any prolonged bleeding after circumcision or other minor cuts in the past.
